response.justification: The candidate brings well over 8 years of software development experience and genuinely relevant developer-tooling depth — authoring a D test runner (Trial), an assertion library (Fluent-Asserts), building CI/CD and device-orchestration infrastructure, and teaching test-automation courses. However, the resume shows no explicit people-management experience: every title is an individual-contributor role (Senior/Staff Engineer, Founder), with no evidence of direct reports, performance reviews, one-on-ones, or org-level change leadership, which are the core requirements of this Level II Manager position. Mobile-platform exposure is thin (a single iOS/tvOS stint in 2015-16) relative to a role supporting a large mobile ecosystem. Worth a screening call to probe informal leadership and founder-level team management, but the management bar is not demonstrated on paper.
strengths: Deep, hands-on developer-tools and test-infrastructure track record (Trial, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD, GitLab/Docker pipelines)
15+ years across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded, comfortably exceeding the 8-year minimum
Strong engineering-culture advocacy: TDD, pairing, trunk-based development, plus workshops and courses taught to other engineers
concerns: No documented people-management experience or direct reports against a 2-year minimum
No evidence of roadmap ownership, performance management, or leading organizational change
Limited and dated mobile-platform experience for a role centered on a major mobile ecosystem

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and test infrastructure expertise
